text:
[LGRA.5.8.1] `Json` is the fallback `field_type` for opaque adapter
payloads. Accessed via standard dot/bracket operators;
leaves are runtime-typed. Adapter usage policy at
[LADP.5.5]; rule-side access and type-mismatch semantics at
[LEXP.7.12].

idris.name: Lgra_5_8_1__json
idris.note: The document a `Json` slot holds: a tree of leaves -- the JSON null, a Bool, an integer, a float, a string (its text, as a String value's) -- arrays and objects, each leaf of the kind it was written with. Access is `lnul_8_4__resolve`'s, by the dot and bracket segments of `Lgra_5_8_5__seg`; what a leaf reads as is `lnul_8_4__read`'s.

idris.name: Lgra_5_8_5__seg
idris.note: The clause's dot and bracket operators as path segments: a member by its key, an element by its index.
